title: Topic 17: Weather & Seasons - Vocabulary
description: Core words for weather & seasons: weather, sun, rain, snow, wind, hot, spring, summer, autumn, winter. 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
introductionText:
weather = sun? rain? hot? cold? - that!
sun = the hot yellow one in the sky
rain = water from the sky  |  snow = white, very cold!
wind = air that moves - whooosh!
hot = very very warm (summer!)
seasons: spring (flowers) -> summer (hot!) ->
autumn (wind) -> winter (cold, snow)
+ phrase bank: What is the weather like? | It is
raining now. | The sun is out.
+ grammar note: NOW = am/is/are + -ING:
It is raining. I am watching the rain!

grammarBlocks.title: PRESENT CONTINUOUS (G10): It is raining. / I am watching TV.
grammarBlocks.explanation: PRESENT CONTINUOUS (G10): It is raining. / I am watching TV. + THE CONTRAST with simple present: It rains every winter (habit - T7) vs It is raining NOW. A1 includes continuous for NOW only - continuous for future arrangements is A2 and stays out.
patterns: am/is/are + verb-ing (I am writing, it is
CONTRAST: It rains every winter. <-> It is

explanations.A1-T17-VOC-Q1: Rain = water. Snow = white and very cold.
explanations.A1-T17-VOC-Q4: Hot = the opposite of cold (T5!). Hot day -> thirsty (T5!).
explanations.A1-T17-VOC-Q5: Weekend (T16) = Saturday + Sunday, in EVERY season!
explanations.A1-T17-VOC-Q6: What is the weather like? -> hot/cold + rain/sun/snow.
explanations.A1-T17-VOC-Q7: It IS snowing. We ARE watching. (am/is/are + -ing = NOW)
explanations.A1-T17-VOC-Q8: Every winter = habit -> rainS (T7). Right now -> IS rainING. This contrast = strong A1!
